categories.evidence: Refactors core block and header validation method signatures across src/validation.cpp, src/validation.h, and src/consensus/validation.h.
categories.rationale: Retires an error-prone validation API idiom where boolean return values could diverge from mutable BlockValidationState out-parameters. The PR description notes that returning validation state by value excludes 'the potentially inconsistent case when the bool return value and the returned state are inconsistent' and removes unintuitive state pollution across chained calls. While beneficial for validation robustness and isolation, it is an internal interface refactoring without urgent user-visible impact.
